REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - OCTOBER 24, 2019 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
City Council Chamber
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

This section is reserved for comments related to Consent Calendar Items and items not listed on the Agenda but within the subject matter jurisdiction of the City Council/Successor Agency. Comments are limited to 5 minutes per person.
7.
Consent Calendar
Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

11.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.
12.
Closed Session

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
OCTOBER 24, 2019, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Pastor Scott Hines, Generations Church.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Cerritos Recreation Services Division Youth Flag
  Football Team - Gladiators.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor/Chair Naresh Solanki

  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu was excused from the meeting by unanimous
  consensus of the City Council.

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations

  Proclamations were made by the City Council as follows:

  Friends of the Cerritos Library (National Friends of Libraries Week).

  Tri-City Dental Care of Cerritos (Business Spotlight).

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Sumeet Bidani thanked staff and the City Council for addressing Cerritos residents’
  concerns regarding truck noise on City streets, expressed concern regarding truck
  traffic and noise on Carmenita Road, and requested that staff keep working on the
  matter until the traffic and noise issues are resolved.

  Mel Cortez stated that the recent Public Safety Town Hall meeting was well-attended
  and expressed concern regarding the future Metro station that will be located in
  Artesia and the effects it will have on a group of Cerritos residents.

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting Minutes of
  October 7, 2019 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7A.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting Minutes of October 7, 2019
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Yokoyama, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Hu (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated October 24,
  2019 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the Register
  of Demands as follows:

  City of Cerritos  10/24/2019  $1,889,937.59 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Yokoyama, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Hu (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and introduce AN ORDINANCE OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING CHAPTER 5.35 AND CHAPTER 22.40 OF THE
  CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE TO PROHIBIT THE SALE OF ELECTRONIC CIGARETTES
  IN THE CITY OF CERRITOS, HEREIN REFERENCED AS DEVELOPMENT CODE
  AMENDMENT 2019-5 (COUNCIL).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) of the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Advance Planning Manager. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments.

  Lionel Trias spoke in opposition to the prohibition of the sale of electronic
  cigarettes in Cerritos.

  Brian Buenaventura spoke in opposition to the prohibition of the sale of electronic
  cigarettes in Cerritos.

  Darrion Woodard spoke in opposition to the prohibition of the sale of electronic
  cigarettes in Cerritos.
 City of Cerritos  October 24, 2019
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 5

8.  Public Hearings (continued)

8A.  (continued)

  Dave Cusi, Vape Revolution owner, spoke in opposition to the prohibition of the
  sale of electronic cigarettes and submitted a document for the record.

  Sumeet Bidani spoke in support of the prohibition of the sale of electronic
  cigarettes in Cerritos.

  Paul W. Bellenbaum requested that the proposed Ordinance be placed on the
  ballot.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed the
  public hearing and public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Yokoyama, and seconded by Pulido, to:

  1. Approve Development Code Amendment 2019-5, making the findings set forth
  in Cerritos Planning Commission Resolution No. 2019-28; and

  2. Waive full reading of and introduce Ordinance No. 1028, AN ORDINANCE
  OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING CHAPTER 5.35 AND CHAPTER
  22.40 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE TO PROHIBIT THE SALE OF
  ELECTRONIC CIGARETTES IN THE CITY OF CERRITOS, HEREIN
  REFERENCED AS DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2019-5 (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Yokoyama, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Hu (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS GRANTING AN EASEMENT DEED TO

  157 FEET SOUTH OF PARK PLAZA DRIVE ALONG SHOEMAKER AVENUE, CERRITOS,
  CA 90703 (APN 7030-011-011) (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Dario Simoes, Assistant City Engineer. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to waive full reading of
  and adopt Resolution No. 2019-23, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS GRANTING AN EASEMENT DEED TO SOUTHERN
  CALIFORNIA EDISON FOR UTILITY PURPOSES LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 157
  FEET SOUTH OF PARK PLAZA DRIVE ALONG SHOEMAKER AVENUE, CERRITOS,
  CA 90703 (APN 7030-011-011) (COUNCIL).

9A.  (continued)

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Yokoyama, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Hu (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

9B.  Review and consideration of award of a contract for purchase, installation and
  programming of two (2) LCD projectors for the Cerritos City Council Chamber, Bid
  No. 1389-19 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Laurie Kajiwara, Public Information Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Artelliah Johnson inquired as to the location of the proposed new projectors and of
  the bid process for the potential purchase

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public
  comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Pulido, to award a contract for
  the purchase, installation and programming of two (2) LCD projectors for the
  Cerritos City Council Chamber to Digital Networks Group, Inc. in the amount of
  $23,657.79, Bid No. 1389-19 (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Yokoyama, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Hu (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation.

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.

  Reports were provided by Councilmembers Edwards and Pulido, Mayor Pro Tem
